    for i in range(1, p_input):

    for i in range(p_input):
        if not visited_flag[i]:

            index = i
            product_tmp = 1
            while not visited_flag[index]:
                visited_flag[index] = True
                index = arr[index]
                cycle_len += 1
                product_tmp = (product_tmp * k_input) % p_input

                result = (result * multiplier) % MOD_CONST

                assert product_tmp == 1
                result = (result * p_input) % MOD_CONST
